mapper.select: SELECT S.S_CD, MI.NAME, GR.GR, S.H_PAY, SA.EXP_YN , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(MI.SSN2, 1, 1) IN ('1', '3') THEN '남' WHEN SUBSTR(MI.SSN2, 1, 1) IN ('2', '4') THEN '여' ELSE '확인필요' END AS GENDER , CASE WHEN SUBSTR(MI.SSN2, 1, 1) IN ('1', '2') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1899 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MI.SSN1, 1, 2))) WHEN SUBSTR(MI.SSN2, 1, 1) IN ('3', '4') THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE) - (1999 + TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MI.SSN1, 1, 2))) ELSE -1 END AS AGE FROM S, RES R, S_APPLY SA, MEM M, MEM_INFO MI, GR WHERE M.MEM_CD = MI.MEM_CD AND M.MEM_CD = SA.MEM_CD AND SA.S_APPLY_CD = R.S_APPLY_CD AND S.RES_CD = R.RES_CD AND S.GR_CD = GR.GR_CD AND S.S_CD = #{sCd}
SELECT W.WEEK FROM WORK_DAY WD, WEEK W WHERE WD.WEEK_CD = W.WEEK_CD AND WD.S_CD = #{sCd}
SELECT S.SIZ FROM CRB_SIZE CS, SIZ S WHERE CS.SIZ_CD = S.SIZ_CD AND CS.S_CD = #{sCd}
SELECT L.LCS_CD, L.LCS_TY, L.LCS_NAME, L.REG_NUM, L.LCS_MAN FROM OWN_LCS OL, LCS L WHERE OL.LCS_CD = L.LCS_CD AND OL.S_CD = #{sCd} ORDER BY OL.LCS_REG_DATE
